name: Doctrine Feature
summary: Doctrine Feature Shock Trooper Once per short rest, reroll one damage die for a lasgun, autogun, shotgun, or bolter. Marksman Accurate weapons gain +1 damage when you did not move. Sergeant When an ally within 30 ft fails a fear or Suppression save, use your reaction to let them reroll it.
